content.short: Cardano Gamers is a crypto based gambling / gaming project building on Cardano.
content.description:
Cardano Gamers plans to become the first lottery syndicate running on Cardano. Regularly hosting a number of different games, betting opportunities and chances to purchase shares in an Australian national lottery syndicate. Interacting and partaking in these opportunities / activities will require the native Cardano Gamers token [$CGT].

Most games will be hosted manually with the use of a ‘random number generator’ or a ‘spin the wheel app’. The Cardano Gamers website will have information regarding to upcoming future draws /games and also past draw information. Cardano Gamers Tokens will periodically become available for swap / purchase on the website this will be done to slowly grow the circulating supply of $CGT which also allows more people to partake in activities and also to help fund larger prize pools for future draws.

Cardano Gamers has plans to bringing future utility to the token, things such as the release of staking vaults and NFT’s that bring extra utility. The $CGT total supply has been capped at 10,000 tokens with the initial circulating supply being just a few hundred.

For more information it is recommended to periodically check the official Cardano Gamers website or social media profiles as this is where information, news and updates will first be released. Good luck gaming!
